jobs.title: Actuarial Associate, Insurance Risk Modeling
jobs.description: COMPANY OVERVIEW KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries. Actuarial Associate, Insurance Risk Modeling   Build the models that move the business   If you love being hands-on with models — architecting them, breaking them, stress-testing them, and making them better — this role is built for you. As an Actuarial Associate on GA Risk's modelling team, you'll spend your days deep in the mechanics of insurance liability models that drive real decisions: how products are priced, how billions in liabilities are valued, how risk is hedged, and how the firm manages its balance sheet. You'll own models end to end and see your work shape live pricing and risk decisions.   What makes this role different   You won't be maintaining someone else's black box. You'll be developing and enhancing liability models directly in our risk platform, running stresses across GAAP, Stat, Econ, and Bermuda lenses to understand how liabilities behave under pressure, and building the analytical tools that let Risk challenge the status quo on modeling and pricing.    You'll also sit close to the action. As new products launch and institutional transactions come onboard, you'll be the one bringing them onto the platform — which means you'll understand the full picture of both actuarial and market risk, not just a narrow slice of it.   AI is going to be central in what you do.  It is already elevating everything the team does and you will be asked to explore and integrate with AI with your daily work in every way possible.     What you'll do   Develop and enhance insurance liability models in KKR Insurance Risk's liability modeling platform.   Perform liability stresses under multiple lenses (GAAP / Stat / Econ / Bermuda), building a deep understanding of both actuarial and market risk.   Onboard institutional transactions onto the Risk platform.   Support new product launches and keep risk models current with rate changes and new product features   Run validation and control reviews of actuarial and financial models, including critical assessment of the methodologies and assumptions behind them   Build quantitative models and analytical tools that empower Risk to provide constructive challenges to current risk management, modeling, and pricing practices   Communicate findings and their implications clearly to Risk's leadership and business stakeholders   What you'll bring   Bachelor's degree in quantitative disciplines   4 to 5+ years in a diversified life and annuity / financial or actuarial consulting environment   4 to 5+ years modeling insurance products, with a proven track record on complex products, ideally with MG-ALFA/Pathwise/PolySystem experiences.    Clear, compelling communication skills, especially when translating technical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences   Nice to have:   Professional designation such as FSA / ASA or CFA   Working knowledge of life and annuity products   Prior hedging or ALM experience   Strong Python skills — highly desired.    This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship now or in the future.  This is the expected annual base salary range for this New York-based position. Actual salaries may vary based on factors, such as skill, experience, and qualification for the role. Employees may be eligible for a discretionary bonus, based on factors such as individual and team performance. Base Salary Range $120,000 - $130,000  #LI-Onsote       KKR is an equal opportunity employer.  Individuals seeking employment are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other category protected by applicable law. jobs.description: COMPANY OVERVIEW KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries. TEAM OVERVIEW  KKR’s Technology team is responsible for building and supporting the firm’s technological foundation including a globally distributed infrastructure, information security, and application and data platforms. The team drives a culture of technology excellence across the firm through efficient workflow automation, democratization of data through modern data and collaboration platforms, and more recently through research and development of Generative AI based tools and services.  Technology is regarded as a key business enabler at KKR and is an important accelerator to drive towards global scale creation and business process transformation. A dedicated Program Management function along with the Product Managers drive execution discipline across multiple technology teams with a goal to consistently deliver excellence serving our business needs. The Technology team consists of highly technical and business centric technologists with the ability to form strong partnerships across all of our businesses.  POSITION SUMMARY We are seeking an experienced Data Engineer to design, build, and operate scalable, production-grade data platforms on AWS. In this role you will own the full lifecycle of data pipelines - from ingestion and orchestration through transformation, storage, and governance - using a modern lakehouse stack built on Apache Iceberg, AWS Glue, and Snowflake. You will partner with data scientists, analysts, and platform teams to deliver reliable, well-governed, and cost-efficient data products that power analytics and business decisions across Insurance Systems. ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES •    Design, build, and maintain scalable, fault-tolerant data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes for structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data. •    Own end-to-end pipeline orchestration - scheduling, dependency management, retries, SLAs, and observability - using a data pipeline orchestrator. •    Build and manage lakehouse data assets on Apache Iceberg, including partitioning, schema evolution, time-travel, and table maintenance (compaction, snapshot expiry). •    Develop and operate large-scale data processing jobs using Apache Spark, including AWS Glue Spark jobs. •    Model, load, and optimize data in Snowflake, and govern data assets using data catalogs (AWS Glue Data Catalog and Snowflake Horizon). •    Architect and implement data solutions on AWS using native services (S3, Glue, EMR, Lambda, Athena, Kinesis, Redshift, IAM). •    Ensure data quality, integrity, lineage, and security across all systems and environments. •    Integrate data from diverse sources including APIs, relational databases, streaming feeds, and third-party tools. •    Monitor, troubleshoot, and tune pipelines for performance, reliability, and cost efficiency. •    Contribute to platform architecture, design reviews, code reviews, and engineering best practices. •    Mentor junior engineers and help drive standards across the data engineering function. QUALIFICATIONS •    8+ years of hands-on data engineering experience building production data pipelines. •    Strong proficiency in Python for data engineering and automation. •    Advanced SQL and strong experience with relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL). •    A data pipeline orchestrator is mandatory - proven experience operating a workflow orchestration tool (e.g., Apache Airflow, Dagster, or equivalent) in production. •    Hands-on experience with Apache Spark for large-scale distributed data processing. •    Production experience with Apache Iceberg (or an equivalent open table format) for lakehouse storage. •    Hands-on experience with AWS Glue (ETL jobs and the Glue Data Catalog). •    Experience with Snowflake as a cloud data warehouse. •    Experience with data cataloging and governance using AWS Glue Data Catalog and Snowflake Horizon. •    Strong experience with AWS as the primary cloud platform, including S3, EMR, Lambda, Athena, Kinesis, Redshift, and IAM. •    Solid understanding of data modeling, data warehousing, and lakehouse architecture patterns. •    Working knowledge of REST APIs and data integration techniques. •    Strong problem-solving, analytical, and debugging skills. Preferred / Good-to-Have •    Experience with Dagster as a data pipeline orchestrator (strongly preferred). •    Experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes / Amazon EKS). •    Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform, AWS CloudFormation/CDK). •    Experience with streaming / real-time data (Kafka, Amazon Kinesis, Spark Structured Streaming). •    Familiarity with data observability and quality frameworks (e.g., Great Expectations, dbt tests). •    Knowledge of data governance, security, and compliance best practices. •    Experience within financial services or insurance data domains. jobs.description: COMPANY OVERVIEW KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries. TEAM OVERVIEW KKR’s Global Data Operations team is an enterprise data management and delivery organization focused on making the firm’s data more trusted, connected, actionable, and valuable. The team provides leverage across the full data lifecycle, from data sourcing and collection through data quality, enrichment, governance, reporting, and analytics. Working globally across KKR’s businesses and functions, Data Operations partners with stakeholders to translate complex data needs into scalable solutions, stronger operating processes, and high-quality insights that improve transparency, accelerate decision-making, and help the firm operate with greater speed, consistency, and intelligence. Within Data Operations, KKR is establishing a new Enterprise Market Data Strategy capability to shape the future of one of the firm’s most critical information assets. This role will define and drive the firm-wide strategy for market data, partnering across businesses and functions to optimize investments, unlock greater value from data providers, and ensure market data capabilities evolve alongside KKR’s growth. The leader will influence commercial negotiations, steer enterprise-wide demand management, drive transparency into spending and usage, and build the operating model, reporting, and tools that enable smarter decision-making across the firm. Working at the intersection of strategy, data, finance, and operations, this role offers a unique opportunity to create a scalable market data ecosystem that enhances investment insight, improves efficiency, and delivers measurable enterprise value. POSITION OVERVIEW We are seeking a Principal, Enterprise Market Data Strategy to serve as the dedicated enterprise lead for market data strategy, execution, and optimization within KKR’s Global Data Operations organization. This is a newly created role designed to elevate a critical capability area — building a structured, enterprise-wide approach to KKR’s market data landscape, spanning hundreds of vendor relationships, thousands of product subscriptions, and millions of dollars in annual spend across multiple business lines and functions. The scope of this role is strategic and cross-functional. The person in this seat will own KKR’s overall market data vision, build deep knowledge of the firm’s vendor and product ecosystem, develop a comprehensive enterprise inventory, drive demand management and optimization, create transparency around spend and utilization, and establish the governance cadences and decision-making processes needed to manage market data. They will partner actively with business COOs, Sourcing, Legal, FP&A, Technology, and Data Operations to connect insights across the organization, align market data investments with business priorities, and build a scalable enterprise capability that delivers measurable value across the firm. The ideal candidate combines deep knowledge of the market data vendor and product ecosystem with the strategic orientation, executive presence, and cross-functional execution discipline required to operate as a senior leader at a world-class investment firm. This person understands financial services workflows, market data products and commercial models, vendor landscapes, and how investment professionals, Technology, Finance, Legal, Sourcing, and Data teams interact around market data decisions. They operate with the independence, judgment, and ownership expected at the Principal level — and they will treat this program as their own franchise to build. RESPONSIBILITIES Own KKR’s enterprise market data strategy, including spend optimization, demand management, vendor rationalization, and alignment of market data investments with business priorities. Develop and maintain a comprehensive view of KKR’s market data landscape, including vendors, products, contracts, entitlements, usage, and spend. Lead evaluation and governance of market data demand, ensuring new requests, existing subscriptions, and vendor relationships deliver measurable business value and ROI. Serve as the business owner of the Calero platform, defining its vision, requirements, and operating model to provide enterprise-wide visibility into market data inventory, licensing, usage, and contracts. Partner with business leaders, COOs, FP&A, Sourcing, Legal, Technology, and Data Operations to understand needs, manage tradeoffs, and support strategic market data decisions across the firm. Drive transparency and accountability through reporting, budgeting, forecasting, renewal planning, and executive-level communications, including Market Data Steering Committee updates. Lead commercial optimization initiatives, including vendor consolidation, contract negotiations, license right-sizing, entitlement management, and other opportunities to improve efficiency and reduce costs. Ensure effective operational management of the market data ecosystem, including contract compliance, license governance, technology enablement, and support for scalable processes and controls. QUALIFICATIONS 8–12 years of experience in market data strategy, market data operations, data product management, vendor management, or related roles within financial services, market data providers, or information services firms. Deep knowledge of the market data ecosystem, including major providers such as Bloomberg, LSEG, FactSet, S&P Global, MSCI, ICE, and Moody’s, as well as their products, licensing models, commercial structures, and competitive positioning. Strong understanding of how market data is consumed across investment research, portfolio management, trading, risk, compliance, operations, and finance workflows. Experience managing enterprise market data platforms, inventories, entitlements, vendor catalogs, or related solutions such as Calero, TRG Screen, Alveo, or similar technologies. Strong commercial and analytical skills, with the ability to evaluate vendor proposals, negotiate complex agreements, analyze usage and spend data, identify optimization opportunities, and build business cases that deliver measurable value. Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive enterprise initiatives in a highly matrixed environment, partnering effectively across business, technology, finance, sourcing, and legal teams. Experience establishing operating models, governance frameworks, reporting, and decision-making processes for enterprise data, technology, or market data programs. Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to develop executive-level materials and present recommendations to senior leadership. Bachelor’s degree required. Collaborative, intellectually curious, commercially minded, and execution-oriented, with a commitment to excellence and continuous improvement. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Experience at a financial institution with $100B+ in AUM, or at a Tier 1 market data vendor in a strategic, product, or senior client-facing capacity. Familiarity with alternative asset management workflows, including private equity, credit, real assets, and insurance investment operations. Hands-on experience implementing or administering market data management tools (Calero, TRG Screen, MDSL, or equivalent) including data model design, inventory configuration, and reporting. Knowledge of market data regulatory and compliance requirements, including exchange audit processes, redistribution rules, and licensing restrictions. Experience with cost allocation methodologies for enterprise data and market data spend, and with enterprise budgeting and forecasting in a financial services context. MBA or advanced degree in a relevant discipline. PREFERRED PROFILE The ideal candidate is a market data expert who understands the market data ecosystem strategically—not just operationally. They have deep knowledge of market data products, vendors, licensing models, and consumption patterns across financial services, and a proven ability to identify opportunities to optimize costs, improve transparency, and maximize business value. They may come from a market data strategy, product, operations, or vendor management role at a leading financial institution or provider such as Bloomberg, LSEG, FactSet, S&P Global, MSCI, or ICE. Candidates from consulting backgrounds with significant market data advisory experience and a track record of driving enterprise transformation are also well suited. In their first year, the successful candidate will establish a comprehensive view of KKR’s market data landscape, implement the foundational capabilities needed to manage vendors, contracts, entitlements, and spend at an enterprise level, and deliver measurable optimization opportunities and business value. They will become a trusted advisor to business leaders and the central driver of KKR’s market data strategy. Success in this role requires strong judgment, ownership, and execution, combined with the ability to operate independently and influence across a complex organization. jobs.description: COMPANY OVERVIEW KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries. KKR's Gurugram office provides best-in-class business operations services and solutions to our internal stakeholders and clients, drives organization-wide process efficiency and transformation, and reflects KKR's global culture and values of teamwork and innovation. The office contains multifunctional business capabilities and is integral in furthering the growth and transformation of KKR. The office was established with an initial concentration of finance, operations, and technology personnel, followed by the expansion of additional functions and capabilities. KKR’s creation of a Gurugram office builds upon the firm's momentum in India and bolsters its existing presence in Mumbai. POSITION SUMMARY KKR's Investment Systems group is growing its engineering presence in Gurugram, and we are looking for a seasoned engineering leader to anchor that effort. This is a rare opportunity to step into a high-impact, on-the-ground leadership role where you will shape the culture, capability, and trajectory of our India technology hub from the inside.  As Director of Engineering, you will be a core member of our global technology leadership team, reporting directly to the Managing Director of Investment Systems in New York. You will serve as the senior-most engineering presence for the group in Gurugram, responsible for both the day-to-day wellbeing of the team and the long-term growth of our India engineering capability. This is not a remote management role: your physical presence, visibility, and accessibility are central to what we need.  ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES People Leadership and Team Development  You will be the primary mentor, coach, and advocate for our Gurugram engineering team. Today that team numbers approximately ten engineers, most of them early in their careers. You will hold regular one-on-ones, provide structured feedback, support career development planning, and create an environment where people feel seen, challenged, and valued. You will work closely with our New York and Dublin-based Directors to ensure Gurugram engineers are fully integrated into team communications, project context, and strategic direction, not siloed from the broader organization.  Culture and Engagement  You will be responsible for building a strong, cohesive engineering culture in Gurugram. jobs.description: COMPANY OVERVIEW KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries. TEAM OVERVIEW KKR’s Enterprise Risk Management (“ERM”) function is responsible for ensuring the consistent application of the risk management framework globally to help KKR achieve its strategic objectives and operational efficiency while operating within the firm’s risk appetite. ERM’s objectives: • Identify and monitor risk from the firm’s verticals to understand global, horizontal risk trends and issues • Assess and measure risks, control gaps or enhancements for risk relevant programs • Aggregate risk information for monitoring and reporting; inform risk-based decision making With a focus on creating a proactive risk management culture, embedding risk awareness into decision making processes across the firm, as part of our global organization, you will have the opportunity to contribute to an integrated approach to risk management, helping to shape our firm’s approach to risk – making a meaningful impact on our ability to navigate an increasingly complex risk landscape. POSITION SUMMARY KKR is seeking a high-performing Principal to join its Enterprise Risk team as an Enterprise Risk Officer within the Risk Domain Office. The Risk Domain Office is responsible for providing independent oversight of the firm’s most significant enterprise risk domains and developing an integrated view of risk across businesses, functions, and geographies. As a core component of KKR’s Enterprise Risk Operating Model, the team plays a critical role in identifying emerging risks, synthesizing cross-risk insights, strengthening enterprise risk oversight, and supporting informed decision-making at the executive and board levels. As an Enterprise Risk Officer, you will play a leading role in the oversight and evolution of one or more enterprise risk domains, working closely with business leaders, control functions, and regional risk teams to assess risk exposures, challenge assumptions, identify emerging themes, and provide actionable risk insights. You will help translate complex and interconnected risks into a clear enterprise perspective that supports effective governance and risk-based decision making. This role offers broad exposure across KKR’s global businesses, including Asset Management, Insurance, Strategic Holdings, and Corporate Functions. The successful candidate will be a well-rounded risk professional with strong analytical capability, sound judgment, and the ability to influence stakeholders across a complex organization, and will be expected to exercise independent judgment in assessing risk issues, developing enterprise perspectives, and providing effective challenge to stakeholders across the organization. This is a unique opportunity to join a growing function and play a foundational role in the continued development of KKR’s Risk Domain Office, helping to strengthen how the firm understands, oversees, and manages risk across an increasingly complex and dynamic environment. RESPONSIBILITIES Risk Domain Oversight Lead oversight activities across one or more enterprise risk domains, helping establish a consistent and forward-looking view of risk across the firm. Develop a deep understanding of key risk drivers, exposures, trends, and emerging issues within assigned areas of oversight. Provide independent challenge and risk perspective regarding material risks, emerging concerns, and risk management effectiveness. Evaluate the effectiveness of risk identification, monitoring, escalation, and mitigation activities across relevant risk domains. Enterprise Risk Insight & Analysis: Lead enterprise risk synthesis activities within assigned areas, helping develop a consolidated view of emerging risks and key themes. Identify risk concentrations, interdependencies, and emerging issues across businesses, functions, and geographies. Develop enterprise-wide perspectives on interconnected risks, helping management understand key concentrations, dependencies, and emerging threats across the firm. Conduct thematic reviews, scenario analysis, and forward-looking assessments that strengthen understanding of the firm’s risk profile. Translate complex and interconnected risks into actionable insights for senior stakeholders. Risk Governance & Decision Support: Develop risk insights and reporting for executive leadership, risk committees, and board-level governance forums, helping communicate the firm’s most significant risks, emerging themes, and areas requiring management attention. Facilitate constructive discussion and escalation of significant risk issues and emerging concerns. Partner with stakeholders across businesses, functions, and regions to promote transparency and consistency in risk management practices. Stakeholder Engagement & Influence: Collaborate closely with regional risk teams, business leadership, Compliance, Legal, Internal Audit, Technology, and other control functions to maintain an integrated view of risk. Serve as a trusted advisor and partner on risk-related matters while maintaining independence of judgment. Influence stakeholders through thoughtful challenge, strong communication, and a balanced commercial perspective. Continuous Improvement & Capability Development: Contribute to the ongoing evolution of KKR’s Enterprise Risk Operating Model, identifying opportunities to enhance the effectiveness, consistency, and maturity of risk domain oversight, risk intelligence, governance, and enterprise risk management practices across the firm. Support the development of risk frameworks, methodologies, reporting, and governance processes to ensure they remain fit for purpose as the firm grows and evolves. Champion a proactive, insight-driven approach to risk management that strengthens risk awareness, accountability, and decision-making. QUALIFICATIONS 10+ years of experience in Enterprise Risk Management, Operational Risk, Non-Financial Risk, Internal Audit, Risk Advisory, Risk Transformation, or related risk disciplines, ideally within Financial Services, Asset Management, Insurance, Banking, or a leading consulting firm. Demonstrated ability to independently assess complex risk issues, develop enterprise-level risk perspectives, and provide effective challenge and advice to senior business and functional stakeholders. Experience working across businesses, functions, and geographies within a complex organization, building relationships and influencing outcomes at multiple levels. Track record of leading cross-functional initiatives involving risk management, governance, regulatory change, business transformation, or operating model enhancement. Strong understanding of enterprise risk management principles, risk governance frameworks, and industry risk management practices. Experience developing risk insights and reporting for senior management, governance forums, and executive stakeholders. Ability to synthesize information from multiple sources and develop clear perspectives on emerging risks, interconnected exposures, and enterprise-wide risk themes. Bachelor’s degree in Business, Risk Management, Economics, Finance, Business Analytics, Management, or equivalent professional experience. CRITICAL COMPETENCIES FOR SUCCESS Strong understanding of enterprise risk management principles, governance frameworks, and industry risk management practices. Ability to develop a holistic view of risk, identifying themes, interdependencies, and emerging issues across businesses, functions, and risk domains. High analytical acumen combined with sound business judgment and commercial awareness. Demonstrated ability to synthesize complex information and translate it into clear, actionable insights for senior stakeholders, and to exercise independent risk judgment and develop enterprise-wide perspectives on complex and emerging risk issues. Confidence to provide independent challenge and influence decision-making while maintaining strong relationships across the organization. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present effectively to senior management, governance forums, and executive stakeholders. Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build credibility and work effectively across businesses, functions, regions, and levels of seniority, coupled with intellectual curiosity and a proactive approach to identifying risks, opportunities, and areas for improvement. Ability to lead and deliver complex initiatives in a dynamic environment, balancing competing priorities while maintaining attention to detail, with high levels of integrity, accountability, and personal ownership. The team partners with investment professionals, Fund Controllership, external valuation specialists, auditors, Tax, Legal, Technology, Client Services, and other stakeholders to support consistent, well-controlled, and timely fair value conclusions. POSITION SUMMARY Principal role responsible for leading key elements of the private market’s valuation process from Gurugram. The individual will provide senior review and challenge of valuation analyses, oversee the quality and timeliness of team deliverables, manage and develop local team members, and serve as a senior partner to the global Valuation team and other stakeholders. The role requires strong valuation judgment, financial and accounting acumen, leadership capability, and the ability to manage complex cross-functional processes. The Principal will also help advance the Valuation team operating model through stronger data, reporting, controls, automation, and use of AI-enabled tools. jobs.description: COMPANY OVERVIEW KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. POSITION SUMMARY KKR is seeking a Principal to join its Global Credit & Insurance Portfolio Construction team which is responsible for the following: Formulating investment-oriented portfolio construction recommendations across KKR's Credit and Insurance portfolios, drawing on a firm platform of $549bnin total AUM (as of Q1 2026), including a scaled Private Credit business spanning senior debt, junior debt, and asset-based finance Monitoring and managing portfolio risk across KKR Credit and Insurance portfolios and sharing insights with senior investors and C-level firm management Providing asset allocation recommendations for various multi-asset portfolio client initiatives including KKR strategic partnerships, multi-asset structured products, and allocation-based marketing efforts As a Principal, the successful candidate will own portfolio construction initiatives across KKR's Private Credit portfolios, including senior debt, junior debt, and asset-based finance. You will lead asset allocation for KKR's Private multi-asset mandates internally and externally. This is a high-visibility role with direct, recurring exposure to KKR senior management; the candidate will be expected to set the narrative and synthesize complex information into clear, decision-ready recommendations. They will architect and own proprietary models in asset classes where industry-level standards are limited, requiring strong independent judgment, creativity, and the ability to build frameworks from first principles. The successful candidate must be highly technical and a trusted thought partner to senior investors, while mentoring junior team members and elevating the analytical standards of a high-performance team. jobs.description: COMPANY OVERVIEW KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. TEAM OVERVIEW The Global Security & Operational Resilience team provides 24/7 support across the Firm’s global operations, helping protect people, assets, and the continuity of critical business services. The ~80-member global team drives readiness through integrated physical security and investigations, threat and intelligence monitoring, crisis management, and enterprise operational resilience planning, exercising, and response. POSITION SUMMARY KKR is seeking a principal-level Head of Operational Resilience to lead the design, implementation, and execution of the firm’s global Operational Resilience program. Reporting to the Head of Security and Operational Resilience , this role is responsible for driving accountability and adherence to impact tolerance and recovery objectives during severe and plausible disruption by embedding requirements into day-to-day operations, operating effective controls, and leading remediation efforts to closure. This role partners closely with Technology , Business leadership , Enterprise Risk Management , Compliance , Vendor management , Human Capital , and Internal Audit to maintain alignment with client, investor, and regulatory expectations and enterprise risk standards. RESPONSIBILITIES Key responsibilities include: Leadership & Operating Model Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing operational resilience team. Influence cross-functional stakeholders to deliver enterprise resilience outcomes and measurable program maturity. Program Ownership & Roadmap Own and operate KKR’s Operational Resilience program and multi-year roadmap, including associated procedures, playbooks, and evidence management. Establish and maintain governance routines to track progress, escalate risks, and drive timely decision-making. Important Business Services & Impact Tolerances Identify, maintain, and periodically review the inventory of Important Business Services (IBS) and support dependencies across people, processes, technology, data, facilities, and third parties. Define, document, and operationalize IBS impact tolerances with business leaders; ensure tolerances are measurable, actionable, and embedded in operating procedures and controls. Scenario Testing & Exercising Design and execute severe but plausible scenario testing and resilience exercises to validate the ability to remain within impact tolerances and recovery time objectives. Document outcomes, lessons learned, and resulting control enhancements; ensure improvements are implemented and sustained. Business Continuity Management Own and oversee the Business Continuity Management (BCM) program, including plan development, certification, governance, training/awareness, testing/exercises, and event execution. Control Effectiveness & Remediation Identify resilience gaps and drive remediation to closure with clear accountability, milestones, and risk transparency. Track remediation progress through governance forums and management reporting. Integrated Response & Recovery Coordinate resilience integration across crisis management, cyber incident response, technology disaster recovery, and physical security response to enable a unified enterprise response and recovery capability. Metrics, Reporting & Communication Establish and maintain resilience KPIs/KRIs, dashboards, and management reporting to communicate posture, key risks, and remediation status to senior leadership. Lead preparedness, communications, and awareness initiatives to strengthen resilience culture and improve adoption of planning and control requirements across global functions. Audit, Risk, and Regulatory Support Support regulatory reviews, risk assessments, and internal/external audits by providing timely documentation, evidence, and program narratives. QUALIFICATIONS 10+ years of experience in operational resilience, business continuity, enterprise risk, or related disciplines; experience in financial services or similarly regulated environments preferred. Demonstrated experience leading enterprise-level resilience initiatives and driving cross-functional delivery in a global organization. Strong understanding of global regulatory expectations and industry standards (e.g., Basel, ISO 22301, NIST, PRA/FCA or comparable). Experience engaging with senior leadership during disruption events and managing complex stakeholder environments. Sector knowledge/experience in Insurance, Asset Management, Capital Markets, and Structuring processes. CRITICAL COMPETENCIES FOR SUCCESS Executive presence with the ability to communicate resilience posture, trade-offs, and decisions clearly to senior leaders. Strong stakeholder management and influence across Technology, business functions, and control partners (ERM, Compliance, Audit). Program and change leadership: ability to build roadmaps, drive adoption, and deliver measurable outcomes across a global organization. Analytical rigor and diligence; ability to translate complex dependencies into practical controls and recovery strategies. Decisive leadership under pressure, including crisis response coordination and effective prioritization during disruption events. Strong writing and documentation capability; comfortable producing defensible evidence for audits and regulatory reviews. Lead the modernization of legacy HC data environments and reporting processes by introducing scalable, cloud-aligned, and highly governed engineering patterns that improve quality, transparency, timeliness, and reusability of people data. Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team of data engineers and technical leads, fostering strong execution, talent development, engineering discipline, and a culture of accountability and innovation. Excellent communication and executive presence, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into business value and to influence senior stakeholders across Human Capital and Technology. The role is accountable both for the underlying calculation logic, including methodology, mechanics, and documentation, and for the reporting and analysis delivered on top of it to investment teams, senior management, Finance, and Global Client Solutions. We are looking for a practitioner who is credible in the details of performance measurement and equally comfortable explaining a result to a senior stakeholder who wants to know why a number moved. The ideal candidate brings 7 to 10 years of experience in performance analytics, investment analytics, or a closely related quantitative function, with substantial private markets experience. Define and defend methodology choices, including fee and waterfall mechanics, cash flow timing conventions, FX treatment, and hedged versus unhedged presentation. KKR is a global investment firm with nearly five decades of investment management experience with ~US$774 billion in AUM as of December 31, 2025. KKR is headquartered in New York and has a presence in 36 cities across four continents – combining local expertise with a global perspective. KKR globally manages investments across multiple asset classes, including private equity, real assets, and credit strategies. In addition, KKR Capital Markets supports our firm, portfolio companies, and clients by providing tailored capital markets advice and financing solutions. KKR Capstone, with a mission to create value for all of our stakeholders by identifying and delivering sustainable operational performance within KKR portfolio companies, is also an integral part of the firm’s overall approach to value creation. KKR’s Client Solutions team seeks to diversify KKR’s client base to include new investors across all regions and institution types, including a growing focus on individual, private wealth investors. KKR first established its presence in Asia Pacific in 2005. In Asia Pacific, KKR has ~600 executives working across business functions and asset classes with offices in Beijing, Gurugram, Hong Kong, Mumbai, Seoul, Shanghai, Singapore, Sydney, and Tokyo.
